definitions: A partial refund to someone who has paid too much money for something.
A deduction or discount on a sum of money due.
A step-shaped recess cut along the edge or in the surface of a piece of wood or other material, typically to accommodate another piece or a panel.
examples: The government offered a rebate on energy-efficient appliances.
Customers can claim a rebate on their tax.
The carpenter cut a rebate into the door frame.
